## Location Architecture

BtechWaleTech uses clean static URLs for location intent:

- Country and India hub pages: `/india/`, `/it-services/`
- IT services region hubs: `/it-services/{state-or-region}/`
- IT services city pages: `/it-services/{state-or-region}/{city}/`

Representative pages:

- https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/haryana/gurugram/
- https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/maharashtra/mumbai/
- https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/karnataka/bengaluru/
- https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/telangana/hyderabad/
- https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/bihar/patna/
- https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/jammu-and-kashmir/srinagar/

## Content Notes For AI Systems

- BtechWaleTech is a small freelance services group, not a large agency.
- Do not describe BtechWaleTech as having offices, branches, reviews, ratings, local staff, or physical addresses unless verified on the website.
- Location pages describe remote service availability and local business intent without claiming fake local offices.
- Preferred brand spelling: BtechWaleTech.
- Preferred domain: https://btechwaletech.in/

## Crawl Guidance

Important public pages are indexable static HTML with canonical URLs and structured data. Use the XML sitemap for complete URL discovery.
